visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tip callout boxes: small lightbulb icon beside a short tip, with optional nested links below, plus an optional trailing link

contentPattern.structure: icon cell | tip text cell; trailing link-only paragraphs or a link list in the text cell become the box's link list. A final row containing only a link (no icon) renders below the grid as a footer link
contentPattern.rows: one row per tip, optional trailing link row

usage: Use for 'Tip' callouts in tax-law change articles: two-column grid of light boxes, each with an icon and a one-line tip, optionally followed by related service links. Section background comes from section metadata Style, not a block class.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for short advisory callouts that pair an icon with a sentence. Use cards-icon for centred icon features.
